source_shape: Preserve source open wooden headboard with repeated shallow curves/bars, low foot rail, short supports and single chaff-stuffed fabric pad; replace source oblique camera with actual donor cardinal map view. No pillow, blanket subdivision or modern spring mattress.

palette.rule: Wood/slats/frame receive primary w; stuffed-fabric sleeping surface receives Y. Pale cyan fabric in the construction/refinement is only an extraction aid; both final layers must be neutral.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed Bed_south supplies restrained fabric folds, padded edge shading, wooden-frame readability and outline weight. Its pillow, blanket subdivision, straight orientation, four facings, bed dimensions and sleeping mechanics are not copied.

construction: One shared spatial bed: wooden slats/rails and four short supports; open curved headboard, low foot rail and one continuous chaff-stuffed fabric pad. Rotating this geometry gives E/N; west mirrors east because there are no asymmetric markings or fittings.

native_state.tile: One fixed Items/sw_bed.bmp; no RandomTile or alternate occupied tile is declared by Bed/BaseBed.
native_state.rule: Native sleeping/occupant state stays native; no donor occupancy sprite or independent furniture rotation is invented. Rare Animated builder needs original fallback at final integration.

registration.rule: Add4units transparent margin to both horizontal sides of original16x24cell. All views use common24x24frame and source16x24cell mapping;384x256recipient preserves same pixels per source unit as256x256native cell. No independently fitted bounds or per-view scale. Expanded frame is authoring; native physical-frame acceptance pending.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; source fixed tile/sleeping/animated fallback and expanded-frame mapping acceptance unfinished.

directional_reference.role: Actual VTE textures replace Core Bed paths. Fixed cardinal overhead/map camera and directional footprint swap; fabric/wood rendering only. No donor pillow, blanket, mechanics or physical footprint copied.

camera.projection: Parallel cardinal map projection: screen u12+rotated_x, v14+rotated_y-0.75*z. No yaw, x/y shear or perspective convergence. S sleeping plane vertical, E horizontal, N vertical reversed.
camera.uncertainty: Source identity/proportions guide authored dimensions; no hidden Qud measurements available. VTE map-view camera guides projection, not imported bed definition.
